rationale: The agent executed multiple order-changing actions (returns for two items from order #W6239298 and a backpack from #W9218746, plus address and item modifications on pending order #W4860251) without any visible user confirmation, violating the confirm-before-write policy. Authentication appears limited to an email lookup and user details fetch, with no explicit user verification. The agent also did not provide the tracking number for a cancelled order (and did not cancel an order—only processed returns), leaving a key user request unfulfilled. While the actions seem to target the user’s own orders, the absence of confirmations and missing tracking info mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
